sloka: को अपि लोके न मे वेगम् प्लवने धारयिष्यति ।एतानि हि नगस्य अस्य शिला संकट शालिनः ॥४-६७-३६॥
transliteration: ko api loke na me vegam plavane dhārayiṣyati ।etāni hi nagasya asya śilā saṁkaṭa śālinaḥ ॥4-67-36॥

translations.english: Then the tiger among monkeys, Hanuman said to those forestdwellers (monkeys), 'The earth cannot bear the thrust of my leaping.
